invariants: for all phi != Xul, T_phi(B) = B

miss_deficit_contract.description: MISS is an epistemic deficit vector, not an error verdict.

research_pressure_components.D: dependency pressure from unresolved context magnitude
research_pressure_components.R: query relevance from incidence-aware routing channels

miss_deficit_contract.routing_rule: rho_research -> 1 implies acquire evidence before collapse

relevance.cold_start_rule: if key_terms empty and topic_anchor=global then R = clamp(max(0.30, lexical_prior), 0, 1)

priority.query_rule_deferred: P_query = 0.30 when query includes later/optional/whenever/nice to have

resolver_selection.delegate_policy: web-research fallback may override route candidate

isa_extension_contract.rule: AIML categories may only emit ops declared in a domain extension file.

resolver_primitive_contract.dispatch_rule: GraphPlan op -> resolver capability -> resolver primitive op
resolver_primitive_contract.attention_invariance: Resolver primitive changes execution backend, not runtime attention semantics.

resolver_policy_boundary_contract.invariant: Policy constrains attention without becoming attention.
resolver_policy_boundary_contract.yax: Read task requirements/resolver policy and compute EligibleResolvers(v).
resolver_policy_boundary_contract.ranking: Run WCR only over EligibleResolvers(v): mu*=argmax_{mu in Eligible} W_mu*C_mu*R_mu(v).
resolver_policy_boundary_contract.sek: Revalidate capability + policy + XCFE before primitive dispatch.

semantic_attention_shader_contract.authority: Yax defines semantic attention algebra; shader may execute it.
semantic_attention_shader_contract.non_goal: This is not transformer QKV attention.

semantic_hypernym_fold.formal_definition: SHF(h, tau) = < h, B_tau[h,*], N_tau(h), W_tau, State(h) >

components.B_tau_row: typed incidence fingerprint — row of the tau-projected B matrix
components.N_tau_h: neighborhood obtained by unfolding those incidences

typed_projection.override: pass edge_type=all to include all columns

semantic_hypernym_fold.axiom: Fold is structure. Phase is operation / state over that structure.

yax_wsd_contract.description: Yax admission is the word-sense disambiguation mechanism. No separate WSD step is required — sense resolution falls out of the admission gate.

mechanism.active_neighborhood: B_h_active = B_tau[h,*] ⊙ m_h   (local scratch; not persisted)
mechanism.semantics: Same node h (e.g. 'bank') has a full incidence row across all sense-bearing contexts. Yax selects which neighborhood columns activate under the current query Q. The activated subset IS the resolved sense.

yax_wsd_contract.invariant: T_Yax(B) = B — topology is read-only; Yax only constructs the admission mask, never writes back.

resolution_states.VERIFIED: one sense neighborhood dominated — collapse to Xul
resolution_states.AMBIGUOUS: multiple neighborhoods activated with near-equal evidence — Branch/Disambiguate before Sek
resolution_states.MISS: sense-discriminating context was not unfolded — acquire additional Book, re-run Yax → Sek → Ch'en
resolution_states.INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT: Book exists but coverage too thin to gate a sense — widen tau or expand fold
resolution_states.CONTRADICTED: active neighborhood contradicts asserted sense — Revise
resolution_states.INVALID: no legal sense neighborhood exists for h under tau — Reject

yax_wsd_contract.miss_rule: MISS != WRONG. Missing context means the Yax gate cannot fire cleanly, not that the answer is incorrect.

terms.I: importance of the missing context to the requested conclusion

research_pressure.rule: high rho_research => acquire evidence and re-run Yax before collapse

semantic_atoms.description: Coarse-grain sense axes used to anchor admission. Derived from lexical/morpheme cues in derive_semantic_atom_grounding().
semantic_atoms.role: Atoms bias which incidence columns Gate_Q activates, providing a deterministic prior for sense selection before distributional evidence is available.

relation_isa_contract.operator_rule: TRAVERSE is the operation; relation_type is an operand.
relation_isa_contract.typed_projection_rule: B_tau may be projected by relation family/type masks before fold operations.
relation_isa_contract.fallback_rule: When relation_type is requested, @related_to does not silently upgrade it; emit MISS_relation when only weak association exists.

lexicon_attention_contract.lexicon_layer: Unigrams are lexical identity addresses (word->key->Book), not full contextual meaning.
lexicon_attention_contract.ngram_layer: N-grams are contextual association evidence derived from observed corpora.
lexicon_attention_contract.book_layer: Books hold semantic neighborhoods for lexical keys.
lexicon_attention_contract.attention_layer: Yax performs semantic attention over relation-typed neighborhoods, not over raw token frequency.
lexicon_attention_contract.confidence_update_rule: Newer verified confidence rewards may replace older attention weighting through Ch'en candidate updates and Xul commits.

semantic_code_parser_graph.description: Grammar-driven fold-native code structure graph. Any language with a .code-grammar.json becomes queryable via the same fold surface as track nodes.

layer_responsibilities.AST: Normalize surface syntax into canonical node/edge candidates; AST means Abstract Syntax Transpiler.
layer_responsibilities.K'UHUL: Phase execution authority over canonical structure (Pop/Wo/Yax/Sek/Ch'en/Xul).

binary_keyspace_contract.semantic_rule: Binary is a serialization envelope for already-keyed records; tokenization/keying occurs before byte encoding.

semantic_code_parser_graph.granularity_rule: Any source may compile as SyntaxUnit at snippet/block/layout/file/application resolution using one SyntaxGraph contract.
semantic_code_parser_graph.typescript_resolution_note: TypeScript commonly compiles at snippet/construct resolution before file/application composition.

token_object.pattern: string — ECMAScript regex applied to source text

edge_rule_object.kind: string — canonical relation verb (becomes a fold column kind)

edge_conditions.sequence: from_node -> first to_node appearing after it in source position order
edge_conditions.precedes: from_node on the line immediately before to_node
edge_conditions.file: all from_nodes x all to_nodes in the same parse (file-scope)

output_contract.nodes: CodeNode per regex match: id, type, text, line, col, captures
output_contract.edges: CodeEdge per rule application: from, to, kind, weight
output_contract.fold_fingerprints: B_tau[v,*] built from code graph edges — same incidence model as semantic_fold; grammar edge kinds become fold column kinds

mcp_params.grammar_file: string (required) — grammar filename, resolved against data/grammar/
mcp_params.include_fold: bool (default true) — also compute fold fingerprints

semantic_code_parser_graph.fold_queryability: code graph nodes are immediately fingerprint-queryable via the same B_tau incidence surface as track nodes — grammar edge types become fold column kinds

phase_driver_lock.contract: phase execution is gated by per-phase driver artifact presence and SHA-256 integrity under enforce mode

policy.audit: log status and permit execution even if DLLs are missing or pending hash
policy.enforce: deny phase execution when required phase artifact/hash verification fails

multi_track_fold_unfold.description: General mechanism for traversing multiple tracks' semantic spaces via alternating unfold/fold steps within and across K'UHUL phases. Fold and unfold are operations on semantic structure — they do not advance phase. Phase advances independently (vertical transition). Xul alone commits topology.

machine_state_model.state: Ω = (φ, T, s)  where φ = current phase, T = active track, s ∈ {0=folded, 1=unfolded}

coordinates.phi: K'UHUL phase (C6 wheel: Pop/Wo/Yax/Sek/Ch'en/Xul) — answers WHEN/WHERE
coordinates.T: active track (semantic space: MEMORY-µ, TOOL-µ, ELIZA, ...) — answers WHO/WHICH
coordinates.s: fold state: 0 = bounded/compressed, 1 = expanded/addressable — answers HOW

machine_state_model.independence: The three coordinates are orthogonal. A fold/unfold step changes s (and T) but not φ. A vertical transition changes φ but not s or T.

multi_track_fold_unfold.critical_invariant: Fold ≠ Xul.  A fold locally compresses working context into a bounded intermediate state (C_T). It does NOT commit topology. Only Xul's compare-and-commit mutates B.

semantics.unfold_op: unfold(T): expand track T's neighborhood N_τ(h, T) into the active semantic field F_Q.  s → 1.  F_Q grows.
semantics.fold_op: fold(T):   compress what was learned from T into a bounded intermediate C_T.  s → 0.  F_Q bounded.
semantics.formal_traversal: F_Q^(0) → unfold(T_1) → fold(T_1) → C_T1 → unfold(T_2) → fold(T_2) → C_T2 → ...
semantics.semantic_field: F_Q accumulates bounded projections C_Ti from each track. It is the running semantic field, not a commit buffer.
semantics.commit: Xul receives F_Q as evidence and performs compare-and-commit on B. This is the only topology mutation.

horizontal.definition: (φ, T_A) → (φ, T_B)  — same phase, different track
horizontal.description: Change semantic neighborhood without advancing control phase.

vertical.definition: (φ, T) → (φ + π/3, T)  — same track, next phase
vertical.description: Advance control phase within the same semantic space.

diagonal.definition: (φ, T_A) → (φ + π/3, T_B)  — different phase AND different track
diagonal.description: Combine horizontal and vertical in one step; legal but must be declared explicitly.

folds_array_notation.description: Track folds[] declare unfold/fold pairs within a phase. Pairs at the same phase are horizontal; phase change is vertical. unfold precedes fold for each track.

example.note: expand lexical ngram neighborhood before planning
bind bounded ngram evidence into plan context
bound task list and approval state
vertical: Sek picks up Advisor context
horizontal: bring tool context into F_Q
commit F_Q — Xul is the ONLY topology mutation

folds_array_notation.rule: Each phase may contain n unfold/fold pairs (horizontal traversal). Xul terminates the sequence.

scope_accumulation_modes.union: F_Q += N_τ(h, T)   — default; each unfold broadens the active field
scope_accumulation_modes.intersection: F_Q ∩= N_τ(h, T)  — each unfold narrows to the agreement zone; use when tracks must agree
scope_accumulation_modes.weighted: F_Q += w_T * N_τ(h, T)  — W_E weight of the relation edge determines track contribution

micronaut_composition.description: Micronauts are nodes and folds that unfold. When one micronaut needs another's context, it unfolds that micronaut's track horizontally — not via imperative function call but via semantic field expansion.
pattern: unfold(MEMORY-µ)   → prior grammar experience enters F_Q
unfold(ADVISOR-µ)  → Advisor resumes with richer F_Q
micronaut_composition.vs_imperative: This is F_Advisor ↔ F_Research ↔ F_Memory (field coupling), not Advisor calls Research calls Memory (stack).

fold_unfold_as_binary_oscillation.description: The s coordinate (fold state) oscillates: 0 → 1 → 0 → 1 ... while φ advances independently along C6.
fold_unfold_as_binary_oscillation.1_state: unfold = expanded/addressable — N_τ(h, T) visible in F_Q
fold_unfold_as_binary_oscillation.two_dimensions: K'UHUL phase wheel × fold/unfold oscillation × track space — three orthogonal axes of motion

termination_conditions: Xul gramWrite fired (compare-and-commit executed — F_Q → B)
fixed-point: F_Q unchanged after a complete unfold/fold pair
Ch'en FAIL: certificate rejected — abandon current traversal path
multi_track_fold_unfold.depth_note: Depth 6 = one full C6 cycle of horizontal steps. If F_Q has not converged, escalate via rho_research rather than cycling further.

connection_to_miss_routing.rule: MISS → Acquire/Unfold is an instance of this mechanism with depth=1 at the current phase
connection_to_miss_routing.memory_miss: unfold(MEMORY-µ) → fold → bring gram-store evidence into F_Q
connection_to_miss_routing.factual_miss: unfold(WEB-RESEARCH-µ) after advisor response → fold → acquired keys enter F_Q

relation_to_shf.shf_single: SHF(h, τ) = one unfold/fold pair on a single track
relation_to_shf.multi_track: Multi-track traversal = iterated SHF: ∪_i SHF(h, T_i) accumulated into F_Q
relation_to_shf.primitive: Handle → unfold → Neighborhood → Attention → fold → Handle'  — the recursive unit

connection_to_ngram_pipeline.YaxNGram: unfold = open-world admit; fold = Yax gate fires, bounded admitted set
connection_to_ngram_pipeline.SekNGram: unfold = infer_relations brings endpoints into F_Q; fold = scoring bounds them
connection_to_ngram_pipeline.ChenNGram: miss kinds map to specific unfold targets; advisor is an unfold(external)
connection_to_ngram_pipeline.XulNGram: gramWrite is the Xul commit — closes the traversal

runtime_ops.unfold_op: incidence_matrix MCP tool (head=h, tau=T) — returns N_τ(h,T) for scope extension
runtime_ops.fold_op: semantic_fold MCP tool (phase=φ, head=h, tau=T) — compresses to fingerprint C_T
runtime_ops.commit_op: gram_write (phase=Xul) or XulNGram::process — topology mutation, Xul only

sha256.binding: validated at load time by Ch'en/Xul pipeline
